LANGUAGE-GAP (0.26.0): a kind-target beat cannot ask anything about the member it was raised for.
`holds(owned(occasion.target))` -> E-CEL-PROFILE "fact-query patterns take compile-time-ground
literals or `_`" (the message does not mention occasion.target), and `user.bond[occasion.target]`
-> E-UNDECLARED ("[P] reads a rule variable's member only inside a rule cel() guard").
So "is this a duplicate?", "what bond rank is this hero?" cannot be written once for the roster.
Run: lute check-project .   (lore/summon.lute)
